title: Managing a Team Through Layoffs
paragraphs: When company-wide layoffs were announced, Firas, as a team leader, faced the difficult task of communicating the news to his remaining team members while managing his own uncertainty about the future.
Rather than pretending everything was fine, he addressed the team's anxiety honestly, acknowledging the difficulty of the situation while being transparent about what he knew and did not yet know.

Several team members later mentioned that his honesty, rather than false reassurance, helped them trust his leadership during an otherwise deeply uncertain and stressful period for the whole department.

Firas reflected afterward that leading through genuine difficulty required more honesty than confidence, and that pretending certainty during uncertain times often damaged trust more than admitting the truth.
